name: Walking Knee Hugs
instructions: Walk forward; with each step, pull one knee to your chest with both hands.
Stand tall on the supporting leg, squeezing the glute.
Hold the hug for a second, feeling the glute and hip open up.
Step through and alternate legs as you walk.
cues: Stay relaxed outside the target area
longevityNotes: Mobility is use-it-or-lose-it. Ten minutes of daily joint work preserves the ranges that keep you independent — reaching, bending, and getting up from the floor.
overview: Walking Knee Hugs is a beginner mobility exercise for the glutes, performed with just your bodyweight. Regular mobility work keeps joints moving freely and makes strength training safer.
